name: Criar alertas
query:
-- Criar alertas apenas para situações de risk_level ALTO.

INSERT INTO alerts (
    location_name,
    risk_level,
    message,
    observation_id
)

SELECT
    observations.location_name,
    'ALTO',
    COALESCE(observations.risk_reason, 'ALTO'),
    observations.id

FROM observations

-- Considerar apenas observações das últimas 3 horas.
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(observations.risk_level)) = 'ALTO'
  AND observations.observed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours'

-- Não criar outro alerta para a mesma observação.
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM alerts
      WHERE alerts.observation_id = observations.id
  )

-- Evitar duplicados se já existir uma restrição UNIQUE.
ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO NOTHING;

name: Obter pendentes
query:
SELECT
    alerts.id,
    alerts.location_name,
    alerts.risk_level,
    alerts.message,
    alerts.created_at,
    observations.observed_at,
    observations.wave_height_m,
    observations.wave_period_s,
    observations.ipma_warning_level,
    observations.risk_reason,
    observations.source

FROM alerts

LEFT JOIN observations
    ON observations.id = alerts.observation_id

WHERE UPPER(TRIM(alerts.risk_level)) = 'ALTO'
  AND alerts.email_sent = FALSE
  AND alerts.email_attempts < 5

ORDER BY alerts.created_at ASC

LIMIT 20;

name: Obter pendentes
query:
SELECT
    a.id AS alerta_id,
    a.location_name,
    a.created_at,
    a.risk_level,
    a.message,
    a.email_sent,

    o.observed_at,
    o.wave_height_m,
    o.wave_period_s,
    o.ipma_warning_level,
    o.risk_reason,
    o.source,

    i.titulo AS ipma_titulo,
    i.descricao AS ipma_descricao,
    i.ligacao AS ipma_ligacao,
    i.data_publicacao AS ipma_data_publicacao,
    i.fonte AS ipma_fonte

FROM public.alerts AS a

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        obs.observed_at,
        obs.wave_height_m,
        obs.wave_period_s,
        obs.ipma_warning_level,
        obs.risk_reason,
        obs.source
    FROM public.observations AS obs
    WHERE obs.location_name = a.location_name
      AND obs.observed_at <= a.created_at
    ORDER BY obs.observed_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS o ON TRUE

LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        c.titulo,
        c.descricao,
        c.ligacao,
        c.data_publicacao,
        c.fonte
    FROM public.ipma_comunicados AS c
    ORDER BY
        c.data_publicacao DESC NULLS LAST,
        c.importado_em DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS i ON TRUE

WHERE a.email_sent = FALSE

ORDER BY a.created_at ASC;
